answer: A payout is split thus 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The tundra schedule is applied in ferrous and glacier exposes each instalment. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2306 identities would post 3204 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
